<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def handle(fr):
    res=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('b','S') and n['pixels']==8:
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            if 17<=min(rs)<=23 and 25<=min(cs)<=45:
                res.append((n['color'],(min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs))))
    return sorted(res)
def nbar(fr):
    npx=sum(n['pixels'] for n in fr.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='N')
    return npx
b0=handle(current_frame); print("before:",b0,"N",nbar(current_frame))
r=action(['DOWN']); print("DOWN ->",handle(current_frame),"N",nbar(current_frame),{k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','no_impact','level_completed')})
b1=handle(current_frame)
r=action(['RIGHT']); print("RIGHT ->",handle(current_frame),"N",nbar(current_frame),{k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','no_impact','level_completed')})
</parameter>
</function>

def handle(fr):
    res=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('b','S') and n['pixels']==8:
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            if 17<=min(rs)<=23 and 25<=min(cs)<=45:
                res.append((n['color'],(min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs))))
    return sorted(res)
def nbar(fr):
    npx=sum(n['pixels'] for n in fr.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='N')
    return npx
